format: hook in the first 5 s (bold on-screen line + voice); one survivor teaches ONE real survival lesson per video (lesson tag on screen, numbered steps, recap); ends with ONE would-you-rather question (no A/B labels); the user posts the poll; the winning answer drives the next day
cast_rule: only one main person on screen; every other day a new character can be introduced and/or leave
survivor: Cole, former high-school science teacher (glasses, beanie, backpack) - smart, explains the why; hiding in the Bellwood Public Library (stone walls, one door, high windows)

history.lesson: rainwater: 1 in on 1,000 sq ft = ~600 gal; dump first flush; strain; rolling boil 1 min; 1 gal/person/day
history.question: Carry all your water down to the stone basement, OR stay on the roof and keep collecting while the storm lasts

engine: zombie/story/engine.html (native 9:16) - copy to dayNN/episode.html, render with render.js
style: 'What If' style (ref: instagram what_if_survival): second-person narrator ('you', am_michael 1.12), 3-line stakes-card hook, number cards popping on keywords every 1-3 s with real survival math, punch-in cuts, side-cutaway library base (roof/reading room/lobby/stone basement) with camera pans; open each later day with the poll result ('Most of you said ...')
